routes.purpose: Default internal landing route redirects users to the primary agent queue.
Agent queue view for browsing incoming/open tickets and opening a ticket for triage.
Detailed triage workspace for a single ticket, including suggestions, similar resolved tickets, and resolve action.
Live support operations dashboard for team leads and support leadership.

pages.title: Ticket Queue
pages.purpose: Show incoming and open tickets in a queue so an agent can review triage suggestions at a glance and open a ticket for full detail.

data_requirements.name: ticket queue
data_requirements.description: List of new/open tickets with summary metadata and lightweight triage suggestion fields.
data_requirements.notes: API only returns routing_suggestion.team_id, not team name, in the queue list. UI should display team ID only if desired, or label as suggested team unavailable in list view; a team-name display cannot be guaranteed without another endpoint.

api_consumed.usage: Initial page load and manual refresh of queue.

user_actions.effect: Loads up to 100 new/open tickets sorted by newest first.
Re-fetches GET /api/tickets with current query params.

loading_states.description: Show page skeleton and table/list placeholders while queue data loads.
Keep current list visible and show inline spinner/disabled refresh control during refetch.

error_states.ui_response: Show non-blocking error banner and retry option; fall back to default query values if the client generated invalid params.
Show full-page empty/error state with retry action.

empty_states.ui_response: Show empty queue message indicating no new/open tickets available.

pages.title: Ticket Triage Workspace
pages.purpose: Let an agent review full ticket content, inspect suggested priority and routing recommendation, see 3-4 similar resolved tickets with resolution context, and mark the ticket resolved.

data_requirements.name: ticket details
data_requirements.description: Full ticket content, actual priority, suggested priority, routing recommendation, suggested team details when present, actual team details when present, and prior triage metadata.

data_requirements.name: similar resolved tickets
data_requirements.description: 3-4 historical similar tickets with resolution context for agent assist.
data_requirements.notes: Contract supports retrieval but does not promise exactly 3-4 in response shape; UI should render whatever array is returned.

api_consumed.usage: Initial load of the ticket workspace and refresh after resolution.
Load similar resolved tickets when workspace opens; may be fetched in parallel with ticket details.
Submit resolution category and summary to mark the current ticket resolved.

user_actions.effect: Inspect subject, description, ticket metadata, current status, and triage metadata.
Read suggestion value/confidence/model metadata; no edit/save endpoint exists for suggestions.
Read advisory routing suggestion and suggested team details when present. Because assignment endpoint does not exist, UI must present this as recommendation only.
Expand/scan historical tickets and their resolution summaries for guidance.
Open/submit resolve form with required resolution_category and resolution_summary, then refresh or update local ticket state to resolved on success.

loading_states.description: Show ticket workspace skeleton while details load.
Show similar-ticket card placeholders independently so ticket detail can render first if needed.
Disable submit button and show inline progress while POST /resolve is in flight.
Optionally refresh ticket details after successful resolution; show lightweight updating indicator.

error_states.ui_response: Show not-found page with link back to queue.
Show invalid ticket error and link back to queue.
Show page-level error state with retry.
Treat as page inconsistency; show inline error in similar tickets panel while retaining ticket details.
Show inline message that similar historical matches are unavailable for this ticket right now; ticket triage page remains usable.
Show inline error with retry action inside similar tickets panel.
Show field validation errors for missing/invalid resolution category or summary.
Show error toast/banner and offer navigation back to queue.
Show warning that ticket is already resolved and refresh ticket details.
Keep form data, show inline submit error, allow retry.

empty_states.ui_response: Show message that no similar resolved tickets were found.

constraints.description: No API exists to assign/reroute a ticket, update triage notes, or edit suggested priority/routing. The page can display suggestions and resolve the ticket only.
No endpoint exists to fetch team lists independently, so all team names shown on this page must come from getTicketDetails/getSimilarResolvedTickets payloads only.

pages.title: Support Operations Dashboard
pages.purpose: Provide live operational visibility across ticket volume by product line, ticket volume by priority, and average resolution time by team for a selected date range.

data_requirements.name: ticket volume by product line
data_requirements.description: Time-series counts grouped by day and product line.

data_requirements.name: ticket volume by priority
data_requirements.description: Time-series counts grouped by day and priority.

data_requirements.name: average resolution time by team
data_requirements.description: Aggregate average resolution hours and resolved ticket count per team in selected range.

api_consumed.usage: Load and refresh product-line chart for selected date range.
Load and refresh priority chart for selected date range.
Load and refresh team resolution metric table/chart for selected date range.

user_actions.effect: Triggers refetch of all three dashboard datasets with start_date and end_date.
Re-fetches all dashboard endpoints using current date range.
Reads live operational metrics; no drill-down endpoint exists in contract.

loading_states.description: Show skeletons for all metric cards/charts on first load.
Keep current visualizations visible with per-widget loading overlays while new range results load.
If widgets are fetched independently, one chart/table may show loading while others remain interactive.

error_states.ui_response: Show inline form validation on date controls and prevent/undo invalid query submission.

error_states.when: Product line endpoint fails for network/unexpected reason
error_states.ui_response: Show widget-level error and retry for that chart.

error_states.when: Priority endpoint fails for network/unexpected reason
error_states.ui_response: Show widget-level error and retry for that chart.

error_states.when: Average resolution endpoint fails for network/unexpected reason
error_states.ui_response: Show widget-level error and retry for that widget.

error_states.when: All three datasets fail on first load
error_states.ui_response: Show page-level error state with retry.

empty_states.when: Endpoints return empty results for selected range
empty_states.ui_response: Show no-data messaging in affected widgets.

constraints.description: No backend endpoint provides a single combined dashboard payload; frontend should orchestrate three separate requests.
No drill-through or export endpoint exists; dashboard scope is read-only visualization of provided aggregates.

components.name: Internal App Shell
components.purpose: Global layout with top navigation between queue and dashboard.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.purpose: Primary navigation links to Ticket Queue and Dashboard.

components.name: Page Header
components.purpose: Page title, contextual actions, and status messaging.

components.name: Ticket Queue Table/List
components.purpose: Render queue rows with ticket summary metadata and suggestion indicators.

components.name: Ticket Queue Row
components.purpose: Display single ticket summary with open action.

components.name: Status Badge
components.purpose: Visualize ticket status values.

components.name: Priority Badge
components.purpose: Visualize actual or suggested priority.

components.name: Confidence Indicator
components.purpose: Display confidence score for suggestions in a compact way.

components.name: Ticket Detail Panel
components.purpose: Render full ticket subject, description, metadata, and lifecycle data.

components.name: Triage Suggestion Panel
components.purpose: Display priority suggestion, routing suggestion, advisory-only status, model metadata, and suggested/actual team information.

components.name: Similar Resolved Tickets Panel
components.purpose: Container for similar resolved ticket results, empty states, and retry action.

components.name: Similar Ticket Card
components.purpose: Show a historical similar ticket and its resolution context.

components.name: Resolve Ticket Form
components.purpose: Capture required resolution_category and resolution_summary and submit resolution.

components.name: Date Range Filter
components.purpose: Collect valid start/end date inputs for dashboard queries.

components.name: Chart Card
components.purpose: Reusable widget shell with title, loading, error, and empty states.

components.name: Ticket Volume by Product Line Chart
components.purpose: Visualize daily ticket counts grouped by product line.

components.name: Ticket Volume by Priority Chart
components.purpose: Visualize daily ticket counts grouped by priority.

components.name: Average Resolution Time by Team Table/Chart
components.purpose: Display average resolution time hours and resolved ticket count by team.

components.name: Error Banner
components.purpose: Reusable non-blocking error messaging with retry where appropriate.

components.name: Empty State
components.purpose: Reusable no-data and no-results messaging.

components.name: Loading Skeleton
components.purpose: Reusable loading placeholders for page and widget states.

notes.text: Frontend must treat routing as advisory-only because the API contract explicitly leaves assignment unresolved and provides no assignment endpoint.
Frontend should not design ingestion/admin screens because no authoritative import/admin endpoint exists in the API contract.
Frontend should not design authentication/customer-facing flows because the POV is internal-only and auth endpoints are not in contract.
